description.narrative:
Receiving this grant is crucial for our organization's continued operations and effective advocacy efforts. The funds will primarily be allocated towards supportingour dedicated team members, including a communications person, a campaign and policy officer, and acoordinator. Ensuring fair compensation for our staffmembers is essential to maintain their commitment and motivation, enabling them to carry out their duties effectively. (5K)Additionally, a portion of the grant will be allocated towards covering the expenses associated with attending key conferences such as the African MinisterialConference on the Environment (AMCEN) and the Conference of the Parties (COP). These conferences provide invaluable opportunities for us to engage directlywith government representatives and advocate for policies that prioritize renewable energy. By physically submitting our petition on renewables to governmentrepresentatives at these conferences, we aim to amplify our message and influence policy decisions at the highest levels. (10K)
Increased Advocacy Impact: We aspire to advance renewable energy policies and initiatives at both national and regional levels, influencing decision-makers toprioritize sustainable energy solutions. Through targeted advocacy campaigns, engagement with policymakers, and strategic partnerships, we aim to create anenabling environment for renewable energy development in Africa.Enhanced Organizational Capacity: With the support of this grant, we seek to strengthen our organizational capacity by investing in staff training and development,improving operational efficiency, and implementing effective communication strategies. By equipping our team with the necessary skills and resources, we aim toenhance our effectiveness in driving positive change.Broadened Outreach and Engagement: We aim to expand our outreach efforts to engage a wider audience, including youth, civil society organizations, and otherstakeholders. Through educational initiatives, public awareness campaigns, and community mobilization activities, we aim to raise awareness about the importanceof renewable energy and mobilize support for our advocacy goals.Meaningful Participation in Key Events: By attending important conferences and events such as the AMCEN and COP, we aim to actively participate in policydiscussions, network with stakeholders, and advocate for our priorities on renewable energy. Our goal is to ensure that our voice is heard and ourrecommendations are considered in decision-making processes.
Through this project, we hope to gain valuable insights and knowledge that will enhance our organization's capacity to effectively advocate for renewable energyand climate action in Africa. Specifically, we aim to learn:Best Practices in Advocacy: We seek to understand and learn from successful advocacy strategies and approaches employed by other organizations andstakeholders working in the field of renewable energy and climate change. By studying best practices, we can improve our advocacy effortsand maximize ourimpact.Policy and Regulatory Frameworks: We aim to deepen our understanding of existing policy and regulatory frameworks related to renewable energy at bothnational and regional levels. This includes learning about current initiatives, regulations, and incentives aimed at promoting renewable energy adoption andinvestment.Networking and Collaboration Opportunities: We hope to expand our network of contacts and forge new partnerships with like-minded organizations,government agencies, and international institutions. By engaging with diverse stakeholders, we can leverage collective expertise and resources to advance ourshared goals.Capacity Building and Skill Development: We recognize the importance of continuous learning and skill development for our team members. Through participationin workshops, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities, we aim to enhance our advocacy, communication,and project management skills.Monitoring and Evaluation Practices: We aim to improve our monitoring and evaluation practices to better track the impact of our advocacy efforts and measureprogress towards our objectives. By adopting robust monitoring and evaluation mechanisms, we can ensure accountability and demonstrate the effectiveness ofour work to stakeholders.

participating-org.narrative: Africans Rising is a Pan-African movement of people and organisations, working for peace, justice, and dignity. Africans Rising looks to play a critical role on the continent pushing governments, business, and even established global and national NGOs to focus onchallenges African’s deem critical, including demands for a fair global trading system, concrete action to address the effects of climate change and the creation and strengthening of a representative coalition to protect our natural resources and the environment. Africans Rising has a specific focus on issues including: • Expanding space for civic and political action • Fighting for women’s rights and freedoms across society • Focusing on the right to equity and dignity • Ensuring good democratic and corruption-free governance • Promoting climate and environmental justice
